obs: Guss v. Utah Labor Relations Board
“By this language and by the definition of affecting commerce elsewhere in the Act, Congress meant to reach to the full extent of its power under the Commerce Clause.”
National Labor Relations Board v. Reliance Fuel Oil Corp.

"The Act establishes a framework within which the Board is to determine 'whether proscribed practices would in particular situations adversely affect commerce when judged by the full reach of the constitutional power of Congress.'"
